text: Evaluates special functions mathematical physics statistics, including gamma, beta, error, Bessel, Airy, hypergeometric, elliptic zeta functions, real complex arguments, using kernels 'SciPy' library's 'scipy.special' module (https://docs.scipy.org/doc/scipy/reference/special.html).
